title: Banco BPI
text: Banco BPI, formelly Banco Português de Investimento, is a Portuguese private investment bank, currently owned by finance multinational CaixaBank. Founded in 1981, it runs the banking business with companies, institutional and private clients. It is the third largest private Portuguese financial group with assets of €112.9 billion. Chairman and CEO is Fernando Ulrich. The bank is headquartered in Porto.
